title: Low-Dose Naltrexone for the Treatment of Complex Regional Pain Syndrome
official: Low-Dose Naltrexone for the Treatment of Complex Regional Pain Syndrome
summary: The investigators are testing treatment with low-dose naltrexone (LDN) for symptom relief of complex regional pain syndrome (CRPS). Study participants will be randomly assigned to receive either LDN or placebo for a period of several weeks. During this period participants will be asked to attend either in-person or virtual study visits and complete questionnaires.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Upper and/or lower extremity CRPS
* On stable treatment for 1 month
* CRPS for at least 1 year
* Meet the Budapest criteria for CRPS at time of the study.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Any known allergy to naltrexone or naloxone
* Use of prescription opioid analgesics or illegal opioid use
* Current or planned pregnancy.
